BrochureContent.Content:
Gary O'Driscoll & Co. are proud to present this detached two-storey, four-bedroom residence , situated on a mature site extending to around 1 acre, located approximately 1.5 km southeast of Ardfert Village. Originally constructed in the early 1900s, the dwelling is of stone/mass concrete construction with a pitched slate roof and benefits from white PVC double-glazed windows, oil-fired central heating, mains water and electricity, together with an on-site septic tank.

Accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, family room, kitchen, kitchen/dining room, rear hallway, guest bedroom with en-suite, landing, three further bedrooms and a storeroom. A single-storey extension, constructed in 2022, extends to approximately 37 sq. m. (400 sq. ft.) and provides an additional ground floor bedroom, adjoining en-suite and utility room.

While the property has been well maintained, the original section of the dwelling would benefit from modernisation, including upgrades to the plumbing, electrics and general cosmetic finishes.
